question: On a fixed disjoint cohort of root-exposed imported semantic-ray rules, does the rule-derived static-v2 board profile choose different depth-1 root actions than a Unit board profile when hand/promotion/dynamic channels and search limits are held fixed?
changed_premise: A serialized RuleSet with an added ray has now completed the public AlphaBeta search path and exposed legal ray root actions; the prior probe used only the default profile and did not measure action sensitivity to the static-v2 board-price channel.

frozen.setup: same deterministic accepted three-rank layout helper; retain all generation/layout failures without resampling
frozen.ray_selection: from each accepted layout, deterministically select one exposed (type,direction) pair using Random(seed XOR 0x7A91); exposed means type present and at least one legal semantic ray action at root

arms.control: Unit board value: 1000 per non-anchor, 0 anchor

held_fixed.search: AlphaBeta public player; depth 1; max_nodes 10000; qdepth=0; no root tactical scan; TT and ordering disabled; same root/session

exclusions: does not estimate utility or population effects

decision_rule: If any of the 8 paired roots chooses a different action, record the roots as candidates for a separately preregistered utility contrast; do not start that contrast in this run. If no pair changes action, close this root-only sensitivity route and do not infer global ineffectiveness.
scope: One bounded 8-root feasibility screen. Expected under two minutes; no long run or additional worker.
